% Shared Tikz Preamble for Diagram Atomization Pipeline
% Load this in every tikz generated by Phase 5 subagents.
% Do NOT redefine these — use exactly this preamble.

\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}

% Core libraries
\usetikzlibrary{
    arrows.meta,       % arrow styles
    positioning,       % relative placement
    cd,                % commutative diagrams (tikz-cd)
    calc,              % coordinate calculations
    shapes.geometric,  % ellipses, polygons, etc.
    shapes.misc,       % rounded rectangles, etc.
    decorations.markings,  % arrow on paths
    backgrounds,       % background layer
    fit,               % fitting nodes around others
}

% Standard arrow tip
\tikzset{>=Stealth}

% Commutative diagram style
\tikzcdset{
    arrows={>=Stealth},
    row sep/normal=3em,
    column sep/normal=4em,
}

% Common node styles
\tikzset{
    mathnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, inner sep=2pt},
    labelnode/.style={rectangle, draw=none, fill=none, font=\small, inner sep=1pt},
}

\begin{document}
% RP^2 pushout square — CW construction via degree-2 attaching map
% Nodes: S^1 (TL), D^2 (TR), S^1 (BL), RP^2 (BR)
% Left vertical arrow labelled "2" (degree-2 map z -> z^2)
% Top and bottom horizontals are inclusions; right vertical is characteristic map
\begin{tikzcd}
    S^1 \arrow[r, hook] \arrow[d, swap, "2"] &
    D^2 \arrow[d, "\Phi"] \\
    S^1 \arrow[r, hook] &
    RP^2
\end{tikzcd}
\end{document}
